$comment: Source of truth for the Enlight Layer image pipeline. Edit, then run `npm run photos`. crop and drawing.erase = [x,y,w,h] fractions of the RAW file; ROI boxes and retouch = fractions of the PROCESSED image. Thermal ROI options: hot [hx,hy] or [[hx,hy,weight],…] (box fractions), spread [sx,sy] (core radii, box fractions), angle (deg), lum (1 bright=hot, -1 dark=hot, 0..1 = less texture-driven), shape ('ellipse' or polygon [[x,y],…] in box fractions), thermal {…} per-ROI overrides. Photo entries live in scripts/photos/*.json.

thermal.$comment: Ironbow overlay. heat = kL·Ln + kD·core − offset, soft-kneed above `knee` (tanh) and clamped, Ln = box luminance stretched to its own 2nd–98th percentile (texture-following), core = (1 − smoothstep(0,1,d))^dExp with d = elliptical distance from `hot` normalised by `spread`. rgb = ironbow(heat)·(1 + detail·highpass) so ribs / bolts / edges read through the colour. alpha = alphaMax · edge feather (feather × box size) · (alphaFloor + (1 − alphaFloor)·smoothstep(0, alphaKnee, heat)). Run 3: alphaFloor 0 + wide feather so only the warm parts of the object are coloured and the region never reads as a box.
